text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Spring arrives once again this year. One day, just as Bamboo Memory's warrior training was reaching a milestone—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so much for today as well!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The time has finally come
to decide the path Bamboo Memory must take.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes, sir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “—After going through all the training journey up to today and pondering it over and over, I share the conclusion I arrived at with Bamboo Memory.”
choice_data_list: Let's run some sprint and mile races

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sprint and mile. Those two distance categories are the stage where,
as her Trainer, I concluded Bamboo Memory is at her strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, that's merely the conclusion I came to.
Unless I hear Bamboo Memory's true feelings and she's convinced, it means nothing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If Bamboo Memory wishes to pursue the Classic Triple Crown route in the middle and long distances just like her friends, then I will reconsider this idea—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Understood-ssu!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm already excited to see
if my legs can hold their own
in sprint and mile races!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course it is, naturally!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Because that's the stage you came up with for me to aim for the absolute highest—for my "dream," right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then all I gotta do is believe in that!
So of course it's fine, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those straightforward words, that gaze, that trust, kindled a faint warmth within my chest that harbored an unconcealable anxiety. But—
choice_data_list: ...It'll be harder to compete against Yaeno and the others, you know?
...It'll be harder to compete against Yaeno and the others, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but put into words
the faint haze lingering in my heart and ask.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Aiming for different distances
means parting ways like that, right?
I mean, sure, I wanna run with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But I really think...
now isn't the time for that, sir.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno, Chiyono O, Ardan-senpai—every single one of them has their own "dream"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"All of them are so passionate, so immense,
and so dazzling...! Everyone is just so
cool! That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I was so moved by the thought that Yaeno and the others
would definitely become the ultimate rivals for me,
just like Oguri-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And...
that's exactly why I also thought this.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My "dream" is to have the greatest showdowns with the greatest rivals. And to have that kind of battle with Yaeno and the others—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If I wanna make my "dream" come true, I've gotta become the best Umamusume myself!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's "dream" is
to make me a strong Umamusume! And I
trust that "dream" more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So I'll run with faith in the path you've shown me, and in the potential you discovered in me, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because that will surely—
grant my "dream"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I want to do everything to live up to this trust. That fervent wish became a beam of courage, clearing away the faint darkness lingering in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I have to put it into words.
As her trainer, in order to guide her 'dream'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Swan Stakes is a GII turf race held at Kyoto Racecourse in late October.
The distance is... 1400m."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A graded sprint race, famous as a stepping
stone for Umamusume whose primary
battlegrounds are sprints and miles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This race should be the perfect test for Bamboo Memory's
potential as she challenges the sprint and mile divisions
from now on...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So that's where my potential gets put to the test, huh!
Oohhhhhh!! I'm all fired up now!!
choice_data_list: Sprints and miles are your battlefield!
Sprints and miles are your battlefield!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!
choice_data_list: And there, become the strongest of your generation!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it!!
I'm gonna be the best Umamusume in sprints and miles!!
And then!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"To everyone in my generation!! To my friends burning with 'dreams'!!
To the one who'll be my greatest rival someday!!
I'll become someone who can stand shoulder to shoulder with you all!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo!!!
Memory!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with our sights set firmly on the Swan Stakes,
our Classic Year got underway once again...!
